copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.intro: If something here infringes your copyright, tell us and we'll take it down while we look at it. Uploaders can respond with a counter-notice.
copyright.no_agent: No copyright agent is set. An admin should add one in Panels' settings.
copyright.how: Use the Report copyright link on the series or chapter in question.
copyright.name: Your full name
copyright.work_help: Describe the original work, and how you hold the rights to it.
copyright.good_faith: I believe in good faith that this use isn't authorized by the copyright owner, its agent or the law.
copyright.accurate: The information in this notice is accurate, and under penalty of perjury I am the owner of the right, or authorized to act on the owner's behalf.
copyright.sent: Thank you. Your claim has been sent to the moderators, and we'll reply by email.
copyright.counter_intro: If you believe this was taken down by mistake, you can respond. We'll send your counter-notice to the claimant.
copyright.counter_signin: Log in as the uploader to respond.
copyright.statement_help: Under penalty of perjury, that you believe the material was removed by mistake or misidentification.
copyright.consent: I consent to the jurisdiction of the court for my address, and will accept service of process from the claimant.
copyright.counter_sent: Your counter-notice has been sent. A moderator decides on restoring it.

settings.label_plural_help: Menus and pages use this word: Comics, Manga, Webtoons, Library…
settings.tag_help: Every chapter gets a real discussion in this tag (and in the series' own tag, when it has one).
settings.approve_members: Members' chapters wait for a moderator
settings.approve_members_help: Groups with "Publish chapters without approval" (moderators by default) are never held.
settings.explicit_help: Explicit series are hidden from guests, from search and from widgets, and only shown to groups with permission who say they're 18 or older. Some places (the UK, several US states) legally require real age verification, which Panels doesn't do: self-declaration may not be enough where your forum operates.
settings.mature_min_days: Days since joining before Mature and Explicit unlock
settings.mature_min_posts: Posts before Mature and Explicit unlock
settings.max_megapixels_help: Checked before an image is decoded. Very large images need a lot of server memory.
settings.pages_per_hour: Pages a member may add in an hour
settings.stock_sidebar: New chapters in the index sidebar
settings.stock_sidebar_help: For forums without FoF Widgets or Page Builder. It steps aside while FoF Widgets shows the same widget.
settings.agent_help: Shown on /read/copyright. Fill these in before opening uploads to members.
settings.strike_limit: Upheld claims before an uploader can't upload
settings.strike_limit_help: Each upheld copyright claim is a strike. At this many, the member can no longer start series or add chapters.
settings.quarantine_days: Days taken-down files are kept for a counter-notice
settings.x_sendfile_help: nginx: add an internal location /panels-private/ pointing to storage/panels. Apache: needs mod_xsendfile.

watermark.on_help: Burnt into every stored copy as pages are processed. Pages uploaded before you turn this on stay unmarked.
watermark.image_help: A transparent PNG, 2 MB or less.
